text: Water freezes at zero degrees Celsius under standard atmospheric pressure.
The Pacific Ocean is larger than the Atlantic Ocean.
A triangle has three sides and three interior angles.
Plants use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide during photosynthesis.
The capital city of Japan is Tokyo.
To boil an egg, place it in simmering water until the center is set.
Earth completes one orbit around the Sun in about one year.
A compass needle points toward magnetic north.
The chemical symbol for gold is Au.
A rectangle has four right angles and opposite sides of equal length.
Sound travels through air as changes in pressure.
The largest planet in the Solar System is Jupiter.
A byte commonly contains eight bits.
Washing hands with soap helps remove dirt and microbes.
The Nile River flows northward into the Mediterranean Sea.
An hour contains sixty minutes.
Honey is made by bees from flower nectar.
The square root of eighty-one is nine.
A thermometer measures temperature.
The first month of the calendar year is January.
Salt can dissolve in water to form a solution.
A bicycle is steered by turning its handlebars.
The human heart pumps blood through the circulatory system.
A map legend explains the symbols used on a map.
The opposite of addition is subtraction.
Light from the Sun takes several minutes to reach Earth.
A leap year usually has three hundred sixty-six days.
Iron can rust when exposed to oxygen and moisture.
The English alphabet contains twenty-six letters.
A seed may germinate when it has suitable moisture and warmth.
